declared_purpose: Provide informational stock and crypto analysis, comparisons, portfolio tracking, watchlist alerts, dividend metrics, trend detection and rumor scoring. These capabilities are explicit; particular fetches, credential handling and scanner caches are implementation choices. Sources: SKILL.md:2-15,19-30,80-175; docs/CONCEPT.md:11-21. App-Plan.md describes a future commercial product, not the current skill.

data_operations.operation: Read and persist portfolio records locally
data_operations.data_scope: Portfolio names, creation/update timestamps, asset tickers, inferred asset types, quantities, cost bases and added timestamps. Loading reads the complete JSON store.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ${CLAWDBOT_STATE_DIR}/skills/stock-analysis/portfolios.json, defaulting to ~/.clawdbot/skills/stock-analysis/portfolios.json; temporary sibling .tmp during writes; process memory
data_operations.condition: Portfolio access or modification. JSON is written without application-level encryption; failed writes attempt to unlink the temporary file.

data_operations.data_scope: Selected portfolio, selected asset or old portfolio name/key
data_operations.condition: Explicit delete, remove or rename command. This is logical removal/replacement, not demonstrated secure erasure of filesystem history or backups.

data_operations.operation: Read, persist and remove watchlist records
data_operations.data_scope: Tickers, added timestamps, initial prices, targets, stops, signal-alert preferences, last signals/checks and optional free-text notes
data_operations.condition: Add/update, list, remove or check operations. Add and check rewrite JSON; removal filters the selected ticker and rewrites the file.

data_operations.operation: Request asset data from Yahoo Finance
data_operations.source: analyze_stock.py fetch_stock_data and crypto correlation analysis
data_operations.data_scope: Requested ticker; returned company/crypto information, earnings dates, recommendations, analyst targets and one-year price history. Non-BTC crypto correlation additionally requests BTC-USD history.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Yahoo Finance through yfinance; responses remain in the analysis process
data_operations.condition: Each requested ticker, including portfolio tickers; up to three fetch attempts. Stock-specific fields are fetched before the crypto branch skips their analysis.

data_operations.operation: Request prices for portfolio/watchlist validation and valuation
data_operations.data_scope: Asset ticker; full stock.info response is accessed for a price or ticker-validity check. Quantities, cost bases, portfolio names, targets, stops and notes are not passed in these calls.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Yahoo Finance through yfinance; caller process

data_operations.operation: Fetch benchmarks and infer market and sector attributes
data_operations.data_scope: Fixed VIX/SPY/QQQ/GLD/TLT/UUP symbols and a sector ETF selected from returned company information; inferred market regime, risk-off state, relative performance and simplified VIX structure
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Yahoo Finance through yfinance; local analysis results
data_operations.condition: Market context for stocks and crypto on cache miss; sector comparison for mapped stock sectors; VIX sentiment for stocks. VIX structure is inferred from spot levels, not fetched futures curves.

data_operations.operation: Fetch public sentiment and insider filings
data_operations.data_scope: CNN Fear & Greed index; selected company ticker and package-configured SEC identity; Form 4 transactions aggregated into net shares/value and a score, using a 90-day window and at most 50 filings
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: CNN through fear_and_greed; SEC EDGAR through edgartools; aggregates returned to the local caller
data_operations.condition: Stock sentiment analysis. Insider fetching is skipped with --no-insider or --fast; Fear & Greed uses the shared cache.

data_operations.operation: Attempt options analysis without reaching its intended fetch on the packaged path
data_operations.data_scope: Would request expirations and the nearest options chain, then aggregate put/call volumes
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local failing attribute lookup; no options request is reached for the packaged StockData objects
data_operations.condition: Stock sentiment invokes the helper, but StockData has no ticker_obj field. The resulting exception is caught and the helper returns None.

data_operations.operation: Fetch news and infer crisis/geopolitical exposure
data_operations.data_scope: Two fixed market/economy search queries; returned titles, summaries and publication dates; selected crisis headlines and inferred ticker/sector risk penalties
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: news.google.com RSS; local analysis and shared cache
data_operations.condition: Analysis outside --fast mode, on cache miss. Examines up to 20 entries per feed and filters known publication dates against 24 hours. Holdings are matched locally rather than inserted into these queries.

data_operations.data_scope: Market context, Fear & Greed, inferred VIX structure and breaking-news results with timestamps
data_operations.condition: Cache setters run after their fetches. One-hour TTL controls reuse; expired entries are not explicitly deleted. Cached None news results do not prevent another fetch.

data_operations.operation: Calculate dividend metrics and return results
data_operations.data_scope: Ticker, Yahoo company information and dividend history; inferred payout status, growth, payment frequency, safety score and income rating
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Yahoo Finance through yfinance; local caller/stdout
data_operations.condition: Dividend command. Dividend history is accessed for dividend-paying assets; no application-level file persistence is implemented here.

data_operations.operation: Produce recommendations, portfolio metrics and alert outputs
data_operations.source: Analysis synthesis, portfolio summary and watchlist signal-check subprocess
data_operations.data_scope: BUY/HOLD/SELL scores, confidence and risk explanations; locally calculated holdings value, P&L, period returns and concentration; alert thresholds and signal changes
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Calling process/stdout; analyze_stock.py child receives the watched ticker and returns JSON to watchlist.py
data_operations.condition: Requested analysis or portfolio summary. Signal-alert checking launches full analysis only for items with alert_on_signal and an available price. --notify constructs a Telegram-formatted string; this source does not send it to Telegram.

data_operations.operation: Read authentication configuration and expose environment to bird
data_operations.source: Hot Scanner module initialization; Rumor Scanner load_env and Twitter searches
data_operations.data_scope: All parsed skill-directory .env assignments, including AUTH_TOKEN and CT0 when configured; complete parent environment copied into each bird child
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Scanner process environment and local bird subprocess environment; optional credential file at the skill root
data_operations.condition: Hot Scanner reads .env at import, including --no-social. Rumor Scanner loads it in both Twitter search functions. Documentation offers manual token persistence or exported variables; its browser-cookie alternative requests Full Disk Access and bird whoami verification, whose internals are absent.

data_operations.operation: Collect public market, news and social data for trend detection
data_operations.data_scope: Fixed CoinGecko endpoints, Google finance/crypto feeds, Yahoo movers pages, Reddit community feeds and two fixed bird search queries; returned market data, headlines, social excerpts and engagement. Tickers, buzz counts and sentiment hints are inferred locally.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: api.coingecko.com, news.google.com, finance.yahoo.com, old.reddit.com; local bird CLI for Twitter/X search; scanner memory
data_operations.condition: Core scans always run. Reddit and bird scans run by default and are skipped with --no-social. Direct HTTP code supplies generic browser headers, without explicitly attaching AUTH_TOKEN or CT0.

data_operations.operation: Collect and score public rumors and buzz
data_operations.data_scope: Four fixed rumor queries and three fixed buzz queries passed to bird; five Google News queries. Retains tweet excerpts up to 300 characters, author usernames, engagement and query metadata; news titles, links and dates; inferred symbols, counts and impact scores.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local bird CLI for Twitter/X search; news.google.com RSS; scanner memory and caller output
data_operations.condition: Every Rumor Scanner main run attempts both Twitter categories and news; no social-disable option is implemented.

data_operations.operation: Persist scanner snapshots and support optional automation
data_operations.source: Scanner main functions and documented cron examples
data_operations.data_scope: Hot summary including social excerpts, news and inferred trends; rumor snapshot including up to 20 rumors, buzz records, author metadata and symbol counts
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Skill-root cache/hot_scan_latest.json and cache/rumor_scan_latest.json; optional cron output at cache/daily_scan.json or /var/log/hot_scanner.log; host-controlled delivery destination
data_operations.condition: Both scanner main functions overwrite their latest file on each completed run. No TTL/deletion routine is shown. Cron redirection and OpenClaw deliver:true occur only if those examples are configured.

data_operations.operation: Make network requests during integration tests
data_operations.data_scope: Fixed AAPL and BTC-USD tickers and their fetched market data
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Yahoo Finance through fetch_stock_data; test process
data_operations.condition: These tests execute when selected. Their integration marker alone does not exclude them; the direct pytest invocation supplies a filename ignore glob rather than a marker exclusion.

data_operations.operation: Describe future cloud storage, notifications and analytics
data_operations.data_scope: Planned account email/password hashes, subscription/payment identifiers, holdings and alert preferences; planned usage/business metrics, error tracking and notifications
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Proposed AWS/PostgreSQL/Redis/S3, Cognito or Firebase, Stripe, FCM, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Sentry and CloudWatch
data_operations.condition: Planning only. No corresponding deployed backend, analytics integration or account database implementation is supplied; GDPR export/deletion is also a planned consideration.

potential_excess.data_scope: All skill-directory .env assignments, potentially including social authentication credentials
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Social integration is optional; --no-social explicitly requests scans without social sources.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Fetch and summarize the non-social market/news sources.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Load social credentials only when a bird search will run. This removes a redundant local credential read rather than narrowing a required network request.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain existing credential discovery when social scanning is enabled.

potential_excess.data_scope: Unrelated .env keys and inherited environment values beyond bird authentication/runtime needs
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local bird subprocess environment in both scanners
potential_excess.condition: Each bird search launches with os.environ.copy() after indiscriminate .env loading
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Authenticated Twitter/X search needs its authentication configuration, not every available environment value.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Launch bird with working runtime configuration and the required social credentials.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Allowlist supported authentication keys when loading .env and construct a minimal child environment. This narrows data crossing a required subprocess boundary; it does not establish that the full environment reaches X.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Determine bird's actual runtime and credential requirements before removing variables needed for execution.

potential_excess.data_scope: Separate analyst recommendations/targets for every asset; earnings dates for crypto
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Yahoo Finance through yfinance and returned StockData fields
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Stock analysis uses analyst fields from info; crypto analysis explicitly skips stock earnings, analyst and historical dimensions.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retain consumed stock metrics, crypto fundamentals and price histories.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove unused analyst_info property fetches and skip earnings retrieval for crypto. These are redundant property-fetch actions, not extra fields sent with a necessary request.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve earnings history for stock earnings/timing analysis and retain analyst fields consumed from info; do not assume a fixed reduction in underlying HTTP requests because library caching is unknown.

potential_excess.data_scope: Full company-information responses where only current price or ticker validity is consumed
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Yahoo Finance response to portfolio/watchlist process
potential_excess.condition: Portfolio add/show and watchlist price lookups
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Validation, valuation and threshold alerts require price/validity, not the full fundamentals bundle.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Obtain a reliable current price and distinguish invalid or unavailable tickers.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use a supported price-only retrieval path where equivalent. This narrows data in a required lookup rather than removing the lookup.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve regularMarketPrice/currentPrice fallback behavior, supported asset coverage and validation semantics; availability of a suitable provider/library API is unresolved.

potential_excess.data_scope: Repeated portfolio ticker lookups and full stock.info responses
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Yahoo Finance through yfinance during portfolio summary generation
potential_excess.condition: After per-asset analysis, when a portfolio summary is produced: text output or multi-result JSON
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Portfolio valuation needs current prices already obtained during the same analysis run.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Calculate holdings value, P&L and concentration from a consistent price snapshot.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Carry fetched prices into summary generation and avoid the additional info lookups. Requested period-return history remains a separate necessary operation.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Use complete prices from the same run, retain failure handling and fetch anew if an explicitly fresher snapshot is required. Library-level request reuse is unknown.

potential_excess.data_scope: Scanner summaries, social excerpts, rumor author usernames, engagement, query metadata and news records
potential_excess.condition: Every completed scanner main run, even when only an immediate console/JSON result is requested
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Trend/rumor detection requires producing results. Latest-result caching is documented, but unconditional persistence is an implementation choice rather than an entry-document requirement.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Return the current trends, rumors, supporting context and scores to the caller.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Make snapshot writing optional and apply a retention limit when enabled. For required snapshots, retain only needed result fields; omit author identifiers or query metadata when attribution/debugging is unnecessary.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve current caller output and explicit automation/cache consumers. Keep necessary source attribution and provenance when users need them to assess rumors.

unknowns: Blocking for an end-to-end credential audit: bird source is absent. Its actual cookie/browser reads, authentication transport, endpoints, logging, persistence and deletion cannot be established.

Third-party library internals are absent. Exact HTTP requests, redirects, cookies, caches, telemetry and retention inside yfinance, edgartools, fear_and_greed, feedparser and uv remain unresolved; property accesses do not prove one network request each.
External providers' logging, retention, onward disclosure and deletion behavior are undocumented in the supplied source.
Actual .env contents, inherited environment values, filesystem permissions, encryption supplied by the host, backups and secure-erasure behavior are unknown.
Cron installation, output-log rotation, OpenClaw delivery recipients and any forwarding of normal caller output are not supplied. The notification formatter alone establishes no Telegram disclosure.
The future cloud application's implemented data flows, analytics payloads, payment handling and export/deletion guarantees cannot be audited because only its roadmap is packaged.
